cli.chat.ready.note: The Imp is waiting for you to write.

cli.chat.thinking.note: What the Imp is doing before the first words of its answer arrive.

cli.chat.answering.note: What the Imp is doing while its answer arrives.

cli.chat.using_tool.note: What the Imp is doing while it uses a tool.

cli.chat.input_hint.note: Faint hint in the empty message field.

cli.chat.input_wait.note: Faint hint in the message field while the Imp answers.

cli.chat.help_hint.note: Short reminder at the right of the status line that the question mark opens help.

cli.chat.tool_use.note: A line saying an Imp called a tool. {imp} is the Imp's name.

cli.chat.tool_result.note: The first line of what a tool returned.

cli.chat.error.note: A problem during an answer. {error} is a plain sentence.

cli.help.title.note: Title of the help card in the terminal chat.

cli.help.close.note: Last line of the help card.

cli.help.scroll_line.note: Help for the up and down arrows.

cli.help.scroll_page.note: Help for Page Up and Page Down.

cli.help.key_wheel.note: Name of the mouse wheel in the list of keys.

cli.help.quit_empty.es: Sale si no hay nada escrito

cli.help.open.note: Help for the question mark key.
cli.help.open.en: Show this help when nothing is written
cli.help.open.es: Muestra esta ayuda si no hay nada escrito
cli.help.open.zh-Hans: 没有输入时显示此帮助

cli.help.key_status.note: Name of the status line in the list of what is on screen.

cli.help.imp.note: Help for the Imp's name and brain shown in the status line.
cli.help.imp.en: The Imp you talk to and its brain
cli.help.imp.es: El Imp con quien hablas y su cerebro
cli.help.imp.zh-Hans: 你在和哪个 Imp 说话,以及它的大脑

cli.help.you.note: Help for the arrow that starts what you wrote.

cli.help.activity.note: Help for the activity word in the status line.
cli.help.activity.en: What the Imp is doing now
cli.help.activity.es: Lo que hace el Imp ahora

cli.chat.welcome_hint.note: Shown under the Imp's name on an empty chat.
cli.chat.welcome_hint.en: Write a message, or type / for commands such as /model, /mcp and /send.
cli.chat.welcome_hint.es: Escribe un mensaje, o / para comandos como /model, /mcp y /send.
cli.chat.welcome_hint.zh-Hans: 输入消息，或输入 / 使用 /model、/mcp、/send 等命令。

cli.chat.running.note: Under a tool call whose result has not come yet.

cli.chat.waiting_for.note: Under a message to another Imp, before it answers. {imp} is its name.

cli.chat.away.note: Status line while the Imp is on another device. {device} is its name.

cli.chat.asleep.note: Status line while a visiting Imp's home device is not connected.

cli.help.tool.note: The marks of a tool call and of a message to another Imp in the chat.
cli.help.tool.en: A tool the Imp used, or a message to another Imp
cli.help.tool.es: Una herramienta que usó el Imp, o un mensaje a otro Imp
cli.help.tool.zh-Hans: Imp 使用的工具，或发给另一个 Imp 的消息
